title: FTPK Season 4: Something in Common

prize.note: the author tops up this prize over time; it started at 153 USDC and has grown one dollar at a time, plus a small native ETH gas preload for the eventual winner

target_format: 12 English BIP39 words, BIP44 Ethereum m/44'/60'/0'/0/0, no passphrase, order recoverable offline once the word set is known

derivation.summary: solve each of 12 independent mini-games to get one BIP39 word each, then derive the standard BIP44 first Ethereum address and compare it to the escrow
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP44 test mnemonic (12x 'abandon' plus 'about'); no author-published worked example exists for this season

difficulty_note: the derivation is certified and the site is fully mirrored; the author's own hint says most games share a common mechanic, likely a number used as a 1-2048 BIP39 index; 1 word is established with confidence (game 1) and a 2nd is a strong candidate (game 10)

leads.title: identify the common mechanic across the 12 games (most likely: each yields a number used as a BIP39 wordlist index)
solve the remaining games directly; the word order is a minor convenience, not a real lock, once the word set is known

sources.title: "A new treasure hunt is live! (Something in common), 12 hidden words, 150 USDC to be won"
"Yes, all the words are necessarily part of the BIP-39 list"
"There is something that almost all the games have in common"
"In Season 4, there is a hidden page to help you with Season 2"

third_party_material: no images, audio, or video shipped; only short quoted author text and the site's own rule text are included
